title: Agentic Ontology of Work 2.0.0 document
description: An AOW JSON-LD document: a @context and a @graph of AOW entities.

@context.description: Must include the AOW context, https://w3id.org/aow/context.jsonld.

ref.description: Identifier of an entity: an IRI, a compact IRI such as aow:AL2, or an id relative to the document base.

WorkItem.title: Work Item
WorkItem.description: The unit of business work that the rest of the ontology is about: a claim, an application, an order, a case, a ticket.

id.description: Stable identifier of the entity. Serialized as the node's IRI.

type.description: The AOW class of the entity (for example, "Intent").

version.description: Version of this entity definition, ideally a semantic version such as "1.4.2".

created_at.description: When this entity or version was created.

created_by.description: The Actor responsible for creating this entity or version.

revision_of.description: The earlier version this entity revises.

item_type.description: The kind of work item, for example "insurance-claim" or "purchase-order".

external_ref.description: Identifier of the item in its system of record.

state.description: Current business state of the item, in the vocabulary of its system of record.

opened_at.description: When the item entered the process.

closed_at.description: When the item left the process, if it has.

^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*:[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$.description: Extension property, namespaced with a prefix.

Signal.title: Signal
Signal.description: A raw, time-stamped trace emitted by a system, a person, or the environment: an event, a log line, a user-interface interaction, a document arriving, a state change, a metric sample.

id.description: Stable identifier of the entity. Serialized as the node's IRI.

type.description: The AOW class of the entity (for example, "Intent").

version.description: Version of this entity definition, ideally a semantic version such as "1.4.2".

created_at.description: When this entity or version was created.

created_by.description: The Actor responsible for creating this entity or version.

revision_of.description: The earlier version this entity revises.

source.description: The system, sensor, application, or channel that emitted the Signal.

payload_ref.description: Where the raw payload is stored, if it is kept.

generated_by.description: The Action that produced this Result, Signal, or Observation.

^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*:[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$.description: Extension property, namespaced with a prefix.

Observation.title: Observation
Observation.description: An interpreted fact about a Work Item, Actor, or Action, derived from one or more Signals and carrying a Confidence.

id.description: Stable identifier of the entity. Serialized as the node's IRI.

type.description: The AOW class of the entity (for example, "Intent").

version.description: Version of this entity definition, ideally a semantic version such as "1.4.2".

created_at.description: When this entity or version was created.

created_by.description: The Actor responsible for creating this entity or version.

revision_of.description: The earlier version this entity revises.

observed_property.description: What was observed, for example "claim_amount" or "handling_time".

observed_value.description: The observed value, in any JSON form.

method.description: How the value was derived, for example "document-extraction" or "rule".

generated_by.description: The Action that produced this Result, Signal, or Observation.

derived_from.description: The Signals an Observation was interpreted from.

has_confidence.description: The Confidence attached to this Result, Observation, Action, or Plan.

^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*:[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$.description: Extension property, namespaced with a prefix.

Objective.title: Objective
Objective.description: A business-level goal expressed in strategic or operational terms.

id.description: Stable identifier of the entity. Serialized as the node's IRI.

type.description: The AOW class of the entity (for example, "Intent").

version.description: Version of this entity definition, ideally a semantic version such as "1.4.2".

created_at.description: When this entity or version was created.

created_by.description: The Actor responsible for creating this entity or version.

revision_of.description: The earlier version this entity revises.

kpi_target.description: The measurable target, for example "claims cycle time -20%".

time_horizon.description: The period over which the Objective is pursued, for example "FY2027".

Intent.title: Intent
Intent.description: A structured, actionable goal derived from an Objective and interpretable by agents, orchestrators, and people.

id.description: Stable identifier of the entity. Serialized as the node's IRI.

type.description: The AOW class of the entity (for example, "Intent").

version.description: Version of this entity definition, ideally a semantic version such as "1.4.2".

created_at.description: When this entity or version was created.

created_by.description: The Actor responsible for creating this entity or version.

revision_of.description: The earlier version this entity revises.

goal_statement.description: What the Intent is meant to achieve, stated as an outcome rather than a procedure.

constraints.description: Free-text constraints that are not (yet) captured as Policies.

acceptable_risk_band.description: The level of residual risk the requester accepts.

status.description: Where the Intent is in its life.

serves_objective.description: The Objective an Intent was derived from.

shaped_by.description: Context that gives the Intent or Task its situational meaning.

concerns.description: The Work Item the Intent, Task, or Action is about.

requires_assurance.description: The highest Assurance Level at which this work may be done. The effective level is the lowest of the Intent's, the Task's, the Skill's, and the performing Agent's autonomy_level.

Plan.title: Plan
Plan.description: An ordered or partially ordered set of Tasks intended to fulfill an Intent, produced by an Orchestrator or other Actor.

id.description: Stable identifier of the entity. Serialized as the node's IRI.

type.description: The AOW class of the entity (for example, "Intent").

approved_by.description: People who confirmed the Action, Plan, or Result before it took effect. Required whenever the effective Assurance Level or a Policy calls for human confirmation.

has_confidence.description: The Confidence attached to this Result, Observation, Action, or Plan.

fills_role.description: Roles the Actor is authorized to fill.
